name: Ashwood Burn
description: A charred forest west of the Salt Coast, burned decades ago by the pyromancer Vatric's catastrophic experiment. Dead trees claw at grey skies, ember pits still glow faintly in the ash, and the ruins of an arcane academy loom at the heart of the burn. The air tastes of old smoke and ozone.
